probes.question: How many annual leave days does a full-time shore employee accrue each month?
probes.span: This entitlement accrues at a rate of 2 working days per month.

probes.question: What is the maximum number of unused annual leave days that can be carried over to the next year?
probes.span: Up to 5 working days of unused annual leave can be carried over and expire on 31 March.

probes.question: By what date must an employee submit a written request to carry over unused annual leave?
probes.span: Employees must submit a written request to their line manager by 31 January to carry over unused annual leave.

probes.question: What is the maximum percentage of estimated costs that can be covered by a travel advance according to the policy?
probes.span: The advance amount is set at 80% of the estimated costs for the trip.

probes.question: How many days does an employee have to submit an expense claim after returning from a business trip?
probes.span: All expense claims must be submitted within 30 days of returning from the business trip.

probes.question: What documents must an employee submit prior to departure to ensure an accurate travel advance calculation?
probes.span: Employees must submit a detailed travel itinerary and expense forecast prior to departure to ensure accurate advance calculation.
